purpose: Calibrate central monster growth against plausible player progression rather than instantaneous full equipment at rank unlocks.

equipment.levelOne: Starting weapon; no armor in the reference
equipment.progression: Optimal reference replaces earlier typical-drop baseline after starter period; retain mixed-slot equipment as a lower-progression comparison.
equipment.fullSetComparisons: Full level-appropriate sets are the intended high-level calibration baseline under the latest user instruction.
equipment.dropOrder: Use plausible mixed-slot scenarios: chest first versus gloves/shoes first; evaluate resulting total defense rather than assume one specific drop order. More than one combination may satisfy the encounter requirement.
equipment.rankTransition: A rank unlock does not guarantee a complete set. Intended readiness may require finding/crafting more pieces or compensating through skills.

starterReference.levels1Through9: Exclude armor from the calibration reference even if a player already finds pieces.
starterReference.level10: At least two armor pieces. Exact slots not fixed.
starterReference.levels12Through13: Expected full R1 set, +0. User expects frequent starter drops.
starterReference.level15: Main progression demands begin. Earlier mention of three pieces is retained as a lower-equipment comparison, not a forced downgrade after full R1.
starterReference.level40AndLater: Full level-appropriate equipment for optimal reference, including configured upgrade/buff assumptions; exact contributions still to be supplied.

passives.intermediateLevels: Class-specific intended optimum; do not audit skill-point availability or exact learning order now.
passives.level40AndLater: User intends full relevant passive progression in the optimal reference; use each class actual permitted definitions/caps when calculating. Exact acquisition timing not being verified.
passives.levelNinety: Same passive system; no invented additional passive progression.

buffs.ownBuffs: Include learned own buffs with actual effects, durations, costs, cooldowns and upkeep. No blanket stat multiplier.

externalBuffs.levelSixty: Include in the expected-world scenario; user expects frequent access to other players' buffs
externalBuffs.exactBuffSet: Pending; do not silently treat every possible maximum group buff as permanently active
externalBuffs.comparison: Keep an own-buffs-only comparison to show the contribution of external buffs, not as the sole expected progression baseline

estimatedOwnBuffImprovement.verification: Not measured; not an instruction to increase all stats by 2–7 percent

soulstones.socketingAccess: First capital visit, typically level 30; later if player delays story
soulstones.numericalContribution: Basic attribute stone values, per-item duplication caps and tutorial grant are defined. Tutorial: two slots across one weapon and one armor item, +2 each, up to +4 in one common eligible attribute. Apply chosen legal loadouts at later levels; direct-stat stone values remain pending.

additionalEquipmentStats.accounting: Compute independently from buffs once values are known. Do not assume they exactly replace any particular buff's contribution.

calibration.reference: Compute complete class-specific optimal reference scenarios at checkpoints. Any aggregate is a summary across complete builds, not a typical population build or cross-class maximum composite.
calibration.monsterHealth: Track actual effective player damage and desired fight duration
calibration.monsterAttack: Track player health and actual physical/magical mitigation
calibration.monsterDefense: Use intended per-type reduction and the established monster-defense formula
calibration.rule: Count each passive, buff, affix and soulstone contribution once; these assumptions do not change runtime stats or approve a new monster growth curve
calibration.difficultyTargets: Define acceptable fight duration/actions, incoming pressure and survival margin for normal solo encounters, with a modest gradual increase at later levels. Exact numeric target bands not yet assigned.
calibration.calibrationLoop: Set desired world challenge -> choose explicit reference progression scenarios -> derive shared HP/attack/defense growth -> verify checkpoints and role profiles. Tune global curves for major drift, not individual level variants for each build.
calibration.growthState: Shared curves and final numbers remain pending. No runtime monster, skill, equipment or database values changed by this design clarification.

worldDifficultyPolicy.authority: Fixed world encounters set progression expectations; individual player builds do not dynamically change monster stats.
worldDifficultyPolicy.overworldIntent: Accessible solo content with a modest, gradual increase in challenge over levels; not exact identical fight duration and not mandatory six-player normal mobs.
worldDifficultyPolicy.referenceMeaning: Class-specific intended optimum with starter exceptions; monsters set progression demands, no dynamic per-player adaptation.
worldDifficultyPolicy.playerAgency: Players may meet requirements through stronger armor, additional equipment pieces, different passive choices, active skill use or other available progression. A weak build may struggle without lowering the monster.
worldDifficultyPolicy.skillGates: Do not impose one mandatory named skill unless explicitly designed; consider alternative ways to meet effective offense and survivability requirements.
worldDifficultyPolicy.bosses: Keep boss/group encounter roles separate from normal solo targets; common scaling must preserve role differences.
worldDifficultyPolicy.noAutomaticLevelSolution: Higher-level dungeon monsters are one tuning tool, not proof that their damage and defenses remain playable; mitigation and group mechanics still require checking.

skillBuildScenarios.primary: Class-specific optimal build at each checkpoint with starter exceptions.
skillBuildScenarios.secondary: Weaker/offensive/defensive/mixed builds may demonstrate progression pressure; they do not set the primary monster difficulty.
skillBuildScenarios.timingAudit: Not requested; explicitly stopped by user.

systems: Socket/soulstones: drops before level 30, capital tutorial around 30, natural gear sockets from 40
Random equipment affixes and ability to improve chosen rolls
Pets and other small progression bonuses
uncertainPowerBudget.numericalAssumptions: Use explicit provisional typical contributions only when ranges and availability are known. Do not silently assume maximum rolls, maximum upgrades, pets or all future bonuses.
uncertainPowerBudget.beforeKnown: Keep contributions separately visible; start with defined equipment/skill requirements and report missing systems as unmodeled. No invented universal percentage.
uncertainPowerBudget.pets: Build creatures first; add a separate with-pet scenario when pet values and access are available. Do not silently count summon skills a second time as a regular pet.

referencePolicy.meaning: Use the intended optimal progression of each individual class at the checkpoint, not a population-average build and not maxima assembled from different classes.
referencePolicy.skillPointTimingAudit: Stopped at user request; level-20 and intermediate skill-point timing differ by character and are not to be researched now.
referencePolicy.unknownBonuses: Plus values, affixes, stones, crafted/dungeon gear and other bonuses require explicit reference values when calculated; do not invent unlimited maxima.
